Puis, du haut de l'un des piliers du Pont de Normandie - qui compte 184 haubans partant de 2 piliers hauts de 214 mètres - Fred nous explique l'intérêt du pont à haubans et pourquoi il a fallu trois ans de travaux pour les seules fondations des pylônes. Mais la particularité majeure de ce pont, c'est son tablier creux en "aile d'avion inversée" où Fred va circuler.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Savez-vous il existe en France une cinquantaine de races de poules et sans doute autant de familles de moutons, de cochons et de bovins ? Beaucoup de ces espèces - dont certaines ont été "fabriquées" par l'homme - sont malheureusement en voie de disparition. Le problème est le même problème pour les fruits, les légumes et les céréales... A l’occasion d’une journée au domaine de la Bintinais, une ferme traditionnelle, Fred et Jamy nous expliquent comment conserver et protéger ces espèces animales et végétales menacées.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: L'équipe de "C'est pas sorcier " prend la direction de la Normandie pour embarquer à bord du trois-mâts le BELEM. Construit en 1896, le BELEM est le dernier survivant de la grande flotte des voiliers de commerce français. Aujourd'hui, c'est un navire-école. Le voyage ne sera pas de tout repos. Il faudra grimper en haut des mâts, à 34 m au dessus des flots pour établir les 1200 mètres carrés de voilure, sans faire de noeuds dans les filins. Hissez ! Amenez ! Enverguez ! Carguez ! Brassez ! Etarquez ! Sous les ordres du commandant, nous allons manoeuvrer les vingt et une voiles à la force des bras comme les matelots gabiers d'autrefois..... Et Fred tient bon la barre ! Hissé O !!!

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Le camion de C'est pas sorcier franchit les portes de l'INSEP, l’Institut National du Sport et de l’Education Physique, où s'entraînent plus de mille champions dans une vingtaine de disciplines. Fred teste ses capacités auprès de sportifs de haut niveau. Sur le tatami, face à Laetitia Tignola, championne de France de Judo, il mesure l'efficacité de ses muscles. Avec les haltérophiles, il met la puissance de ses muscles à l'épreuve, avant de grimper sur un ring de boxe pour il teste leur rapidité. Notre "champion" s'aventure jusque dans les cuisines de l'INSEP pour analyser la nourriture des sportifs.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Le camion de C'est pas sorcier met le cap sur la Bretagne, destination Saint Guénolé, cinquième port de pêche en France. A bord d’un chalutier d'une vingtaine de mètres de long, Fred rejoint l'équipage pour participer à une journée de pêche en haute mer. Repérage des bancs de poissons, lâcher et remontée du filet, traitement du poisson, vente à la criée… les différentes étapes de la pêche en mer n’auront plus de secret pour vous.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy nous emmènent au CNES et MATRA ESPACE à Toulouse pour tout connaître sur la conception et les différentes fonctions des satellites. Nous le suivrons dans la salle blanche chez MATRA ESPACE, où l'on découvre la construction d'un satellite d'observation. Puis nous irons au laboratoire thermique du CNES pour assister aux tests que subit un satellite avant son lancement, notamment à l'ouverture de ses panneaux. Jamy nous expliquera où commence l'espace, où circulent les satellites, comment mettre un satellite en orbite géostationnaire etc

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy nous emmènent dans les rues de nos villes, où circulent quotidiennement piétons et voitures. Ils nous parlent des dangers de la route, à la fois du point de vue des jeunes piétons et des passagers d'une voiture. Sur un circuit d'essai, Fred prend le volant d'une " voiture pétard " pour expérimenter son temps de réaction au freinage. Au centre d'études des constructeurs automobiles, nous assisterons au crash-test d'une voiture, et Fred nous montrera comment les mannequins de simulation réagissent à un tel choc. Jamy nous expliquera la différence entre la vision d'un enfant et celle d'un adulte, le temps de réaction quand on est au volant, les effets de l'énergie cinétique sur une voiture et un passager, les effets de l'alcool sur un automobiliste.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy nous font découvrir le fonctionnement du métro parisien, qui accueille chaque jour une moyenne de 5 millions de passagers. Ils se laissent enfermer toute une nuit dans ses galeries souterraines et partent explorer la manière dont le réseau est construit. Ils nous entraînent sur un chantier de construction pour nous expliquer la manière dont on perce un tunnel et rejoignent enfin la cabine d'un conducteur de rame.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy sont partis à Berlin pour rencontrer d'anciens espions. Ils nous font découvrir le Pont de Glienicke, sur lequel l'Est et l'Ouest échangeaient leurs espions. Fred rencontre Yves Bonnet, ancien directeur de la DST, qui nous parle du contre-espionnage et des écoutes téléphoniques. Il suit également le parcours d'une valise diplomatique de l'aéroport de Tegel jusqu'à son ouverture au Quai d'Orsay et nous explique comment les services de renseignements se servent de l'immunité diplomatique pour pratiquer l’espionnage. Quels sont les principaux services de renseignements dans le monde ? Comment ça fonctionne, l'immunité diplomatique ? Qu’est-ce que c’est la cryptologie ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Nous y baignons en permanence… Nous l’utilisons chaque jour… Mais savons-nous vraiment ce qu'est la lumière ? Fred et Jamy se faufilent dans les coulisses du spectacle de Jean-Michel JARRE à la Tour Eiffel, au milieu des 500 techniciens qui préparent leurs batteries de projecteurs, d’écrans géants et de lasers pour le grand show. Avec la complicité des ingénieurs de la lumière, nos deux compères jouent avec les rayons lumineux et les couleurs et nous entraînent dans un voyage à 300 000 kilomètres par seconde. Accrochez-vous, ils vont nous en mettre plein les yeux !

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Le camion de C’est pas sorcier prend la route des studios et suit une jeune chanteuse qui enregistre son premier album. Depuis l'enregistrement de la voix et des instruments sur une bande magnétique jusqu'au mixage, Fred et Jamy égrainent toutes les phases de la préparation du disque. Comment presse-t-on un disque sur un support vinyle ? Et un "laser", comment ça marche ? Pourquoi ce support est-il si sensible à la moindre poussière ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Le camion de C'est pas sorcier s'installe devant la Bourse de Paris. Pendant 26 minutes nous circulons dans les couloirs du Palais Brongniart où l'on découvre le monde financier et ses règles. Nous suivons le parcours d'une action et d'une obligation : qui les achète et qui les vend ? Comment sont fixés leurs prix ? Nous pénétrons ensuite sur le Matif, l'un des derniers marchés où les échanges s'effectuent à la criée.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Des hélices qui révolutionnèrent l'aéronautique aux turboréacteurs les plus modernes, Fred et Jamy nous entraînent au coeur des moteurs d'avion. Nous découvrons avec eux comment sont conçues, puis entretenues, ces mécaniques de très haute précision qui ne peuvent tolérer la moindre défaillance. Comment les hélices assurent-elle la poussée nécessaire à l'envol de l'appareil ? Pourquoi les réacteurs compriment-ils l'air qu'ils aspirent avant de le rejeter violemment ? Quel système a-t-on mis au point pour économiser de l'énergie sur les turboréacteurs des avions de ligne ? Comment les pièces des moteurs d'avion résistent-elles à des températures et à des forces centrifuges extrêmes ? Que se passe-t-il si l'un des moteurs tombe en panne durant le vol ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: En France, environ deux millions de personnes sont exposées à un risque d’inondation. Rien d’étonnant à cela, lorsque l’on sait que le pays est traversé de long en large par 28000 km de cours d’eau… Et des inondations, il en existe de toutes sortes. Fred et Jamy nous font découvrir les différents mécanismes régissant ces phénomènes climatiques, et nous expliquent pourquoi des milliers de personnes se retrouvent régulièrement les pieds dans l’eau.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Le camion de C'est pas sorcier a mis le cap sur l'Amérique du Sud pour nous faire découvrir l'un des désert les plus arides de la planète : le désert d'Atacama. Au nord du Chili, au pied des Andes et à seulement 50 kilomètres du Pacifique, s'étend un paysage minéral impressionnant. Il y tombe moins d'un millimètre d'eau par an. De mémoire d'homme, dans certaines zones de ce désert, on n'a jamais vu la pluie ! La vie y est si particulière que les scientifiques de la NASA viennent ici pour tester leurs robots destinés à sonder le sol de Mars... Fred, Jamy et Sabine sont partis explorer les trésors de cette région unique au monde, avec ses champs de geysers, ses immenses lacs de sel peuplés de flamants roses, ses villages oasis nichés au pied des Andes et ses villes fantômes...

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: En cas de conflit ou de catastrophe humanitaire, comment les avions de la flotte française acheminent-ils hommes et matériel sur le terrain ? Si les avions de chasse devait un jour intervenir... à quoi ressemblerait alors les combats aériens qu'ils livreraient ? Qu'est-ce que c'est exactement, des dommages collatéraux ? Pourquoi les guerres propres n'existent-elles pas ? Depuis les attentats du 11 septembre, comment surveille-t-on et protège-t-on l'espace aérien français ? Fred et Jamy sont sur la base militaire d'Istres, la plus grande base aérienne de France. L'une des plus stratégiques, également, puisque des missiles nucléaires y sont stockés. Ils nous offrent un tour d'horizon de nos forces aériennes;

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Le 16 décembre 2011, le cargo TK Bremen s’échoue sur la côte sud du Morbihan, en Bretagne. Le 13 janvier dernier, le navire de croisière Costa Concordia fait naufrage devant l’île de Giglio, en Toscane. Ces deux évènements récents illustrent à nouveau les multiples dangers de la mer. Avec 11 millions de kilomètres carrés d’espaces maritimes, la France se place au deuxième rang mondial derrière les USA. Qui s’occupe de la surveillance du trafic maritime au large de nos côtes? Quels sont les moyens de sauvetage pour secourir un navire est en détresse ou u n homme à la mer ? Pour le savoir, Fred est allé en Bretagne, rejoindre la flottille 24F de la Marine nationale, puis l’Abeille Bourbon, un remorqueur destiné aux opérations de sauvetage. Jamy, lui, s’est installé dans les locaux de la préfecture maritime, à Brest.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Il y a 15 millions d’hectares de forêt en France. C’est presque 30% de notre territoire ! Ces forêts ne servent pas seulement à se promener au grand air. Elles abritent une grande biodiversité, permettent de stocker du carbone, mais sont aussi exploitées pour leur bois ! Pour comprendre comment l’homme gère une forêt, Fred s’est rendu dans le massif de Fontainebleau pour y suivre le travail des équipes de l’ONF, l’Office National des Forêts. Jamy, lui, a installé son laboratoire à Fontainebleau également, mais dans la maison de l’écotourisme, construite… tout en bois !

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Le Parc National du Mercantour est un joyau naturel situé à l’extrême sud de l’arc alpin, juste avant sa plongée dans la mer. A mi chemin entre la Provence et l'Italie, il offre une variété de paysages, d'animaux et de plantes que l'on ne retrouve nulle part ailleurs. Sa biodiversité attire toujours plus de touristes mais également les scientifiques du monde entier. Sabine est partie à la découverte de cette nature exceptionnelle, accompagnée par ceux qui la connaissent le mieux : les agents du Parc National. Quand à Jamy, il s’est installé dans un chalet traditionnel, au cœur du Mercantour.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Qui ne s’est jamais empressé d’écraser une araignée avec la semelle de sa chaussure, tellement la vision de cet être à 8 pattes est repoussante ? Souvent synonymes de saleté, négligence et de danger, les araignées n’ont pas vraiment bonne presse ! Pourtant, si l’on dépasse les croyances populaires, on découvre un monde fascinant tant par la diversité et même la beauté de ces animaux, leurs modes de vie, leurs tactiques de chasse imparables et les personnalités étonnantes que les araignées regroupent autour d’elles, scientifiques passionnés ou éleveurs amoureux. A travers cette émission, Sabine et Jamy vous proposent d’entrer dans le monde méconnu des araignées, un monde étonnant

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: C’est au royaume des oiseaux, au parc ornithologique de Marquenterre, dans la baie de la Somme, que Fred et Jamy nous attendent équipés de leurs puissantes jumelles. Qu’est-ce qui différencie le squelette d’un oiseau de celui d’un mammifère ? Pourquoi certains oiseaux migrent-ils ? Comment font-ils pour s’orienter ? Comment un œuf se forme-t-il ? Et comment l’oiseau se sert-il de ses ailes pour voler ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Bientôt les vacances, bientôt la plage. Fred et Jamy sont sur la plage de Lacanau et nous rappellent qu’il y a des risques et qu’il faut prendre quelques précautions. Que trouve-t-on dans les eaux de baignades ? Jamy nous expliquera qu’un contrôle très strict de l’eau est effectué pour détecter bactéries, virus et autres polluants et qu’il existe une classification de A à D de la propreté des plages. Le soleil, il faut aussi s’en méfier. Comment peut-on expliquer le bronzage ? Et que se passe-t-il quand on attrape un coup de soleil ? Jamy va tout nous expliquer sur les effets des rayons ultraviolets UVA et UVB sur notre peau et sur la nécessité d’appliquer des crèmes solaires et de porter des lunettes pour préserver notre « capital soleil ». Avant de rentrer dans l’eau, il faut aussi être prudent pour éviter l’hydrocution. Jamy nous expliquera que c’est un choc thermique violent qui est souvent fatal. Sur la plage de Lacanau, Fred suit plusieurs surfeurs avec sa planche de body surf. Les vagues y sont très hautes et très belles. Mais les vagues comment se forment-elles ? D’où viennent-elles ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy scrutent l’univers à partir de l’Observatoire de Haute-Provence et nous parlent des étoiles, galaxies, constellations, supernovas et des nébuleuses. Nous pénétrerons dans la salle du grand téléscope réservé aux professionnels de l’astronomie. En compagnie d’astronomes amateurs, nous essaierons de trouver les constellations avec un téléscope et une carte du ciel. Jamy nous expliquera pourquoi on a l’impression que les étoiles se déplacent dans le ciel, et pourquoi on ne les voie que la nuit. Il nous dira ce qu’est la voie lactée, comment naît et meurt une étoile.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Le camion de Fred et Jamy nous emmène à la ferme aux crocodiles de Pierrelatte dans la Drôme. Cette visite guidée va nous permettre de mieux connaître la famille des crocodiliens : crocodiles, alligators, caïmans... et d’apprendre à les distinguer. Fred nous expliquera quelles sont les conditions de vie des crocodiles que ce soit dans une serre ou dans leur milieu naturel. Il nous fera découvrir les petits crocodiles nés en captivité et assister au repas des adultes. Jamy nous expliquera pourquoi un crocodile a besoin de chaleur pour vivre et comment ces reptiles se reproduisent

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Le printemps, c'est la saison du renouveau. Après de longs mois de repos, la nature reprend vie. C'est le soleil qui va donner le signal de la sortie de l'hiver. Les perce-neiges sortent de terre, les premiers bourgeons apparaissent, les insectes reprennent vie... et les hirondelles annoncent la saison nouvelle. Fred et Jamy nous expliquent les petits miracles de cette saison foisonnante qu'est le printemps. Entre forêts, vergers et potagers, ils nous entraînent dans une jolie promenade pour découvrir avec nous les bouleversements qui se succèdent.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Dans les années 60, de plus en plus de Français peuvent s'offrir une voiture. C'est une révolution ! En 10 ans, on passe de 5 à 12 millions de véhicules. On peut désormais aller où on veut et quand on veut ! Mais cinquante ans plus tard... c'est l'asphyxie ! Les villes s'étranglent sous la pollution et les bouchons. A l'occasion de la journée "Bougez autrement", Fred et Jamy explorent la ville de Lyon et ses transports en commun et s'interrogent sur l'avenir de ce trafic devenu incessant.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Considérant que Noël se fête en Europe en Russie, en Australie, en Afrique du Sud, sur le continent américain et au Japon,- Considérant que 500 millions d’enfants attendent leur cadeau le jour de Noël, et que l’on peut estimer le poids moyen d’un cadeau à 1 kg,- Considérant qu’il y a entre six et huit rennes attelés à un traîneau, qu’un renne mesure en moyenne 1 mètre vingt et pèse un peu plus de 100 kg,- Considérant, enfin, que le Père Noël dispose d’une seule nuit pour remplir le soulier de chacun…Jamy - armé de ses savantes maquettes - s'attaque à cette mystérieuse équation , pendant que Fred expérimente le difficile métier d’assistant du Père Noël !

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred, Jamy et Sabine sont au Château de Versailles. Ils nous font découvrir le somptueux parc que Le Nôtre dessina en l'honneur d'un roi alors tout puissant – Louis XIV, le Roi Soleil. Dans les jardins de Versailles, tout est démesure. Plus de 300 statues, 24 hectares de canaux, des centaines de milliers d'arbres... Par une savante combinaison de terrasses, de bosquets et de miroirs d'eau, Le Nôtre joue sans cesse sur les règles de la perspective et ses effets d'optique pour perdre son visiteur au cours de sa promenade. C'est pas sorcier nous raconte comment l'art et la science du 17ème siècle ont été mis au service d'un projet pharaonique qui deviendra l'un des plus beaux exemples de jardins à la française.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: En 2010, les accidents de la route ont fait 3992 tués et à peu près autant de personnes handicapées lourdement. Un grand nombre de ces drames ont lieu sur des trajets quotidiens ou dans des situations apparemment sans risque. Sur la route, nous sommes tous convaincus d'être de bons conducteurs et nous sous estimons l’imprévu et ses dangers. L'objectif de la Sécurité Routière est de descendre en dessous des 3000 morts dès 2012. Fred a suivi un escadron de la gendarmerie nationale des Yvelines et les « vététistes » de la Préfecture de Police de Paris. Jamy lui s’est installé à l'UTAC (Union technique de l'Automobile, du motocycle et du Cycle), un centre spécialisée dans les essais de véhicules et d’équipements où sont réalisés de nombreux crash tests.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Noël est l'occasion d'une véritable ruée sur les jouets. A travers ses rencontres Fred va nous dévoiler quels sont les jeux les plus en vogues, les normes drastiques auxquelles ils sont soumis avant leur mise sur le marché et pourquoi ils sont si importants dans la vie d'un enfant. Jamy va s'installer dans un grand magasin ouvert pour lui tout seul et va nous décortiquer l'univers du jouet.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Ils ont du mal à lire, à écrire, à compter, à coordonner leurs gestes ou encore à s’exprimer de manière cohérente. Nous nous intéressons aujourd’hui aux enfants atteints de ce que l’on appelle les « troubles dys ». Qu’il s’agisse de dyslexie, de dyspraxie, de dysphasie, de dyscalculie, de dysorthographie, ils seraient en France entre 10 et 15% à souffrir de tels troubles de l’apprentissage. Des handicaps invisibles, qui peuvent aboutir à un échec scolaire massif et à une grande souffrance morale s’ils ne sont pas bien pris en charge. Pour comprendre à quel point ces troubles occupent une place importante dans la vie des enfants qui en sont atteints, Fred va rencontrer de jeunes patients et les adultes impliqués dans leur accompagnement. Jamy, lui, va installer son laboratoire au Neurospin, un centre de référence en imagerie cérébrale près de Paris, où l’on étudie notamment le fonctionnement du cerveau des personnes «dys».

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Depuis l’accident de la centrale nucléaire de Fukushima au Japon en mars 2011, de nombreuses questions se posent sur la sûreté des installations nucléaires. Si un tel accident devait se produire en France, que se passerait-il ? De quels moyens dispose EDF pour faire face à une telle catastrophe ? Comment protéger la population ? Quelles seraient les conséquences à long terme d'un tel accident ? Pour mener l’enquête, Fred va suivre un exercice de crise à la centrale de Cruas-Meysse en Ardèche. Jamy quant à lui va s’installer à l’IRSN, l’Institut de radioprotection et de sûreté nucléaire.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: On nous a longtemps dit que nos ancêtres étaient de vaillants guerriers gaulois, un peuple de barbares. Mais au fil de leurs recherches, les archéologues nous racontent une toute autre histoire des Gaules. Pour redécouvrir cette civilisation, Sabine s’est immergée dans le village gaulois reconstitué de Coriobona, en Charente Limousine. Jamy, lui, est à Bibracte, dans le Morvan. Un grand musée de l’histoire gauloise et un centre de recherche archéologique sont installés ici près d’un oppidum, une ancienne ville fortifiée.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Un fémur long de 2,40 m a récemment été découvert dans une carrière de sable, à Angeac, près d’Angoulême. Il appartenait à un dinosaure qui devait mesurer pas moins de 35 mètres de long, soit l’un des plus gros animaux terrestres que notre planète ait jamais abrité ! Depuis, les plus grands spécialistes français de l’époque des dinosaures ont travaillé sur ce site. Et ils ont non seulement mis au jour les traces d’autres géants, mais ils ont aussi trouvé un troupeau entier de drôles de dinosaures qui devaient être couverts de plumes… Fred les a rejoint sur leur chantier de fouille pour essayer d’en savoir un peu plus sur ces reptiles qui régnaient sur la France il y a 130 millions d’années. Jamy, lui, a installé son laboratoire dans la très belle galerie des dinosaures du Musée des sciences naturelles de Bruxelles

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Chassé, empoisonné ou braconné, le loup avait totalement disparu du territoire français au milieu du 20 ème siècle. Il est réapparu il y a une vingtaine d’année au coeur du Mercantour, dans les Alpes du sud, en provenance d’Italie. Sabine est partie sur les traces de ce prédateur pour mesurer les conséquences de son retour sur la faune sauvage et sur les troupeaux de moutons. Jamy, lui, s’est installé dans un chalet traditionnel, au beau milieu du Parc National.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Quelles sont les limites physiques de l’homme ? Depuis plus de 20 ans les records du saut en hauteur, saut en longueur ou saut à la perche n’ont pas bougé. La devise plus vite, plus haut plus fort est-elle encore de mise ? Pour le savoir Fred va à l’encontre des sportifs français de haut niveau qui excellent chacun dans leur discipline. Jamy, quand à lui, s’installe à l’INSEP, l’Institut National du Sport, de l’Expertise et de la Performance, un pôle de l’excellence où les meilleurs athlètes français s’entraînent à repousser leurs limites dans cette quête permanente de victoire

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Les océans recouvrent 71% de notre planète. Cette immense étendue bleue abrite une biodiversité extraordinaire : plus de 170 000 espèces y ont été répertoriées. Et nous ne cessons d'en découvrir de nouvelles. A moins de pratiquer la plongée sous-marine, la meilleure manière de découvrir la richesse du milieu marin est de se rendre dans un grand aquarium. Cette semaine, C'est pas sorcier nous ouvre les portes de l'aquarium de La Rochelle.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Mammouth des steppes, mammouth de Colomb ou mammouth laineux… A quoi les mammouths ressemblaient-ils ? Sur quelles parties de la planète pouvait-on les croiser ? Avec quels animaux cohabitaient-ils ? Changement climatique, maladie ou chasse intensive… Par quel mystère ont-ils finalement disparu ? Le clonage pourra-t-il un jour les faire revenir ? Fred, Jamy et Sabine dressent le portrait de ce pachyderme mythique, disparu il y a 4000 ans.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Au large du Lavandou, dans l'archipel des Iles d'Hyères, les eaux du Parc National de Port-Cros abritent un écosystème marin exceptionnel. On dirait la Méditerranée telle qu'elle existait encore il y a 50 ans ! Sabine et Jamy sont partis découvrir la richesse de la faune et de la flore de ce sanctuaire sous-marin. Mission : Eponges, anémones, gorgones, étoiles de mer, bancs de sars, de saupes et de dorades, mais aussi barracudas, mérous et coquillages géants.... c'est un véritable festival qui s'offre à nous ! Sabine est partie explorer ces fonds particulièrement préservés avec la complicité de biologistes marins. Nous l'accompagnons dans un comptage de mérous et dans l'arrachage des algues envahissantes.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Le béton est le produit le plus consommé au monde après l'eau ! Résistant, économique, isolant, ce matériau de construction prend toutes les formes et défie les lois de la pesanteur. Seul hic... il n'arrange pas le problème du réchauffement de la planète ! Sa fabrication relâche dans l'atmosphère de grandes quantités de dioxyde de carbone, un gaz à effet de serre désormais tristement célèbre. Fred et Jamy nous emmènent explorer carrières et chantiers pour nous expliquer comment on produit et façonne ce matériau aux multiples vertus, tout en essayant d'en réduire les effets polluants.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred, Jamy et Sabine nous expliquent les règles d'or d'une alimentation équilibrée. Trop de gras et pas assez de vitamines ? Beaucoup de sucreries et le moins de légumes possible ! Voici des cocktails redoutables pour la santé ! Mal manger peut entraîner des maladies graves et favoriser l'obésité. Sabine nous offre un petit éclaircissement sur les aliments qui nous font du bien. Pourquoi faut-il manger ? A quoi servent les lipides, les glucides et les protides ? Dans quelle mesure sont-ils bons pour le corps ? Comment notre appareil digestif fonctionne-t-il ? Comment les nutriments sont-ils dirigés vers les cellules de notre organisme ? Pourquoi grossit-on ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Cette semaine, Fred, Jamy et Sabine nous expliquent tout sur l’histoire des Gaulois, depuis leurs origines celtes jusqu'à la conquête de la Gaule par Jules César. A travers une reconstitution historique, ils nous racontent leur vie quotidienne, leurs pratiques religieuses, leur organisation politique... A quelle période apparaissent les Gaulois ? Où vivaient-ils ? La Gaulle était composée de différents peuples. Comment était-elle organisée politiquement ? Avant l’invasion romaine, quelles sont les relations entre les gaulois et les romains ? Comment étaient organisées les villes gauloises, qu’on appelait alors des oppida ? Comment et pourquoi Jules César a-t-il conquis la Gaule ? Comment César a-t-il vaincu Vercongétorix à Alésia ?

programme.title: Nature Time
programme.desc: Il est temps de se rapprocher de la nature. Appréciée par tous, tous âges et tous niveaux, NatureTime est une chaîne de streaming gratuite qui propose des histoires captivantes sur la faune et la nature du monde entier.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A battle in the beautiful Caribbean Islands. Over 2 days and more than 10,000 spectators expected like previous editions. The cold temperature from the Iceman is changed in 35 degrees hot Martinique. Watch who gets the title in Martinique, events include: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Hercules Hold, Log Lift, and Arm Over Arm Pull.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Zrenjanin, Serbia, again a fantastic stage in the SCL WORLD SERIES TOUR 2024, five events including a super human Yoke race. Who will be the yellow leader for the coming season and take the title with 25 championship points?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Groenlo, east of Holland With the new Talent from South Africa and 2025 Strongest Man of the World - Rayno Nel. The first 3 events are Truckpull, Log Lift and Loading race. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it is the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it is about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland , continues with the last 3 events, here at the venue in Groenlo. The events in this episode are the Conan Wheel, Farmers Walk and the Atlas Stones, with a brutal 200kg stone at the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League: World Record Breakers 2024 kicks off with the Truck Pull, followed by the Front Hold, Frame Carry, Tractor Pull, Shield Carry, Sandbag Toss, and concludes with the intense Loading Race. This two-day competition features all the top strongmen from Finland-and it's one for the history books. Three new world records are shattered, making this a must-see episode for...

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in over 10 years back in Estonia, in Tartu. 12 of the Strongest athletes in the world will fight here for the title and the overall world championship points. You will see 5 crazy events, such as: Boat Pull, Viking Press, Medley, Conan's Wheel and a very heavy Power Stairs!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to Portugal, at the beach of Eposende, to bring you EUROPE'S STRONGEST LATINO. In the beautiful sun of Portugal five cruel events are done in this heat: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Log Lift, Sandbag Toss, Medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A spectacular event on the beach of Gdansk, Poland. A competition in the sand and in the water. Complete with a boat pull. With an impressive line up again, we welcome you to watch us LIVE in the SCL Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League Train stops in Dubai again for the 3rd time, and is now bigger than ever. Hafthor Bjornsson makes his come back here at the SCL DUBAI. You simply cannot miss this most epic show at the World Trade Center in Dubai part 1.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three cruel events in part 1, the World record holder on the deadlift with 501 Kg, will fight for the crown and the title. You simply cant miss this most epic show, at in the World Trade Center in Dubai part 2.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Superhumans arrive in Limassol. Great strongmen from all over the world will compete in the Old Port of Limassol , for the title and championship points. More than ever important this stage, as we come so close to the World Finals in Turkey this year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With 12 of the world's best athletes arriving in Cape Town, South Africa, all fighting for the crown and final ranking points ahead of the World Finals in Turkey. Rayno Nel still needs to qualify along with Brian Kichton also battling for a seat in the World Finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This episode contestants fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever. Twelve finalists from all over the world are in Turkey and will fight for the ultimate title: WORLD CHAMPION 2024.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Part 2 of the world final of the Strongman Champions League tour 2024 in Alanya, Turkey. With three Events down and amazing results. Who will be the new World champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 opens in Joensuu, Finland in freezing -5°C conditions. Athletes battle frame carry as first event on ice and snow. Brian Kichton sets early pace, but Kevin Hazeleger ultimately wins with 27.57s. Competitors from USA, Finland, Turkey and others struggle with cold and debut performances, setting the tone for a global season. Cold conditions define the opening stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 Stage 2 in Riga, Latvia opens by the Baltic Sea with 12 athletes competing in spring conditions. Events include truck pull, log lift, bag toss medley, loading race and Atlas Stones. Home favourite Aivars Smaukstelis returns in emotional final Latvian appearance aiming for his third SCL crown. The competition begins with a truck pull opener setting early times.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 heads to Zrenjanin, Serbia for Stage 3, where elite athletes compete in a packed city-centre showdown. With four debutants joining established names like Evans Nana and Aivars Smaukstelis, competitors face brutal tests including a 16,000kg truck pull as the season builds momentum.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 kicks off in Crema, Italy, for Stage 4 of the season, bringing a world-class lineup to Lombardy. Athletes face brutal tests including car deadlift, log lift medley, Hercules hold, and Atlas stones, as reigning champion Rayno Nel returns fresh from major victory to defend his crown.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Netherlands, for a high-stakes summer showdown. A world-class lineup, including Rayno Nel, Brian Kichton, and Evans Nana, battles in extreme 35°C heat across six brutal events such as truck pull, Viking press, and Atlas stones, as the fight for SCL glory intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Holland, for Stage 5 as athletes resume Day 2 of competition in a tight battle for the SCL title. With only three events remaining, competitors face a brutal sandbag loading race and other heavy tests, as Kevin Hazeleger and Rayno Nel fight for the overall lead.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League heads to Joensuu, Finland, for Stage 7 as athletes battle to be crowned the World’s Strongest Viking 2025. Twelve competitors face nine gruelling events in a high-stakes showdown, with top contenders like Brian Kichton, Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana fighting for crucial championship points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Esposende, Portugal, for the World’s Strongest Latino contest. Twelve elite athletes battle through a truck pull, deadlift, log lift, bag toss and medley in front of a packed crowd. Early leader Juan Ferrer sets the pace, as Invernizzi and others fight for top honours.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Farnborough, England, for the 2025 World Championship Truck Pull at the British Motor Show. Top international athletes compete in this spectacular test of strength, pulling massive vehicles as crowds gather for a thrilling showcase of power and endurance.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Stage 10 of the Strongman Champions League 2025 arrives in Gdańsk, Poland, where a world-class lineup competes in tough events including deadlift, log lift, and loading race. With top athletes like Aivars Smaukstelis and Adam Roszkowski in action, the battle intensifies as the season nears its climax.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Siófok, Hungary, by Lake Balaton for a crucial late-season showdown. Reigning champion Adam Roszkowski returns to defend his title against a stacked field, including Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana. With World Finals approaching, the battle for points intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League makes its U.S. debut in Toledo, Ohio! In day 1 of 2, fourteen world-class athletes battle for the SCL USA title across four powerhouse events — including a Super Medley featuring a car push, Fingal’s Finger, and a stone-breaking challenge. Other highlights include the Front Hold with a whiskey barrel, a keg toss into water, and a gruelling 130,000 kg boat pull - capped off by an electrifying Guinness World Record attempt.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: It’s the final day of the Strongman Champions League’s first-ever U.S. event in Sandusky, Ohio. Athletes face a massive gas tanker truck pull, a unique shovel deadlift, and Atlas Stones weighing 120–200 kg - plus a thrilling Guinness World Record attempt. Who will claim the SCL USA crown?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Dubai for its penultimate stage before the World Finals. Elite athletes battle across gruelling events, including the dumbbell press, deadlift, and bag toss. With fierce competition and rankings on the line, every point counts in the race to qualify for South Africa.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League continues in Dubai for the final stage before the World Finals. Twelve elite athletes battle gruelling events near the Burj Khalifa, with Ramin Farajnejad leading after three rounds. With fierce competition and last chances to qualify, the stakes couldn’t be higher.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals begin in Uppington, South Africa, after a global season of elite competition. Top athletes gather for a dramatic showdown, led by reigning champion and hometown hero Rayno Nel, as they battle in extreme events for the ultimate strongman title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals continue in Uppington, South Africa. With three wins already, hometown hero and World’s Strongest Man Rayno Nel leads the competition, backed by a passionate crowd. As athletes battle by the Orange River, the fight for the title and $50,000 intensifies.

programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League kicks off its 2014 season in Martinique.

programme.desc: The second stage of 2014 Strongman champions League, in Cologne, Germany. 14 athletes from 12 different countries battled through six events on the second stop

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.desc: The first ever SCL in Zambia! The athletes get to take in some of the stunning sights and go on to do events such as Tyre Flip and Log Lift

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The competition moves to Romania and for the first time this season the athletes compete in rainy conditions which make the events even tougher

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Episode 14 takes place in Estonia where drama and world records will be seen again

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Taking place over 2 days in Malaysia, this is part 1 of the world finals of Strongman Champions League!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League - we find out who is crowned as world champion today in the second part of the final epsiode

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Across seven rivers, through mountains and forests, 12 strongmen go to toughest places to find out who is strongest Viking in the World and open a new season of Strongman champions league for 2015. Events like the Hercules Hold, Yoke Race and pulling a real Viking ship are some of the ingredients of this fantastic show.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The second stage of Strongman champions league will be hosted in Germany, by FIBO - the leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health worldwide with 300,000 visitors in four days. Special implements like the biggest log in the world or the special Bavarian stone lift are not only a challenge, but also an opportunity for new personal, national and world records.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Holland is hosting 12 different countries with 14 of the strongest men in the world for the third stage of the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Zydrunas Savickas, one of strongest people on earth is in this competition which has attracted the attention of the audience in the battle for the title of strongest man in Finland. The next round of SCL is in Bulgaria.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stage of the competition is in Bulgaria where Ervin Katona (SCL World Champion 2012) will compete for the last time.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Krzysztof Radzikowski, the leader in the league will fight hard to keep Dainis Zageris off from the title and to gather another 25 ranking points in this next stage in Latvia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The competition sees a close battle with a new world record in overhead dumbbell and close finishes throughout the day. This stage is in Croatia, in a city over 1700 years old, steeped in Roman tradition and history, the athletes arrive for the truck pull after a picturesque boat ride on the Adriatic Sea.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are now half way through the SCL 2015 and getting closer to the grand world finals in Turkey. The eighth stage is in Poland, the home country of the current leader Krzysztof Radzikowski.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage we go into the mountains of Austria to find out through six grueling events who is the strongest in the land of Alps. Martin Wildauer, current World Champion 2014 and Austrian local is competing alongside Zageris, Radzikowski, Belsak and many others.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 10th stage of this year's competition in Strongman Champions League is held in the Romanian city of Sibiu where the 12 strongmen continue to compete for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 11th stage is the SCL Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. In this championship, each competitor must lift three different weights overhead. Zydrunas Savickas is the current world record holder in the Log Lift.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Autumn claims her ex-boyfriend, D’Andre, abused her, which he denies. Why does she defend him to her parents?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation continues with D’Andre, who blames his abusive relationship with his ex-girlfriend, Autumn, on her upbringing.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Recently, parents across America were googling “Who is Andrew Tate?” making him number three in Google searches for 2022, right behind Queen Elizabeth and Donald Trump. Tate claims to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. However, in August 2022, Tate was banned on social media for his misogynist viewpoints. Twenty-four-year-old Ben says when he was a teen, he had zero self-esteem, never got past the first date, and felt powerless with girls. He tells Dr. Phil that men like Tate inspired him to break out of his shell -- and he shares how. Then, a healthy debate about “toxic masculinity” with the “Godfather of the Manosphere," a scholar and author, a men’s rights attorney, and the CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Andrew Tate is known for his misogynistic social media posts and videos claiming to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. Tate is fighting a legal battle in Romania right now, but should parents worry about his influence on their sons? Before Tate was detained, Dr. Phil spoke with Richard Reeves, senior fellow at the Brookings Institute and author “Of Boys and Men: Why the Modern Male is Struggling, Why it Matters, and What to Do about It”; Marilyn York, a men’s rights attorney; Imran Ahmed, CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate; and blogger and author Rollo Tomassi. Plus, hear from a group of teenage boys who surprise their mothers when they share what they think about Tate. And, Robin joins the conversation.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nicky, 17, says she loves to fight and proudly posts the videos of the brawls on the Internet. The teen brags that she once cracked a girl’s head on the concrete, has broken cheekbones and noses, and has had so many confrontations, she's lost count. She says the police have been called to her home as many as 80 times, and she’s been arrested monthly since she was 13 years old. What’s at the root of her rage? Dr. Phil delves deep into Nicky’s past to find the source of her pain. And, Nicky’s mom, Yvette, says she feels helpless and fears her daughter will end up dead or in prison, but is she modeling bad behavior? An anonymous letter to the show makes shocking allegations against Yvette. Can Dr. Phil get this family help -- before someone gets really hurt -- or worse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Levi and Bob say their once-perfect, honor roll student, Tiffani, has changed into someone they don’t know, and she is terrorizing the family. Levi says the 15-year-old is mean and evil, drinks, steals and fights with her every day. In one altercation, Levi says Tiffani spit in her face, punched her and threatened to push her off a balcony, and now she’s afraid for her life. Bob says Tiffani doesn’t respect discipline or any authority -- including the police. Tiffani has been in juvenile detention three times, and Bob says each time she's released, her behavior only escalates. Dr. Phil takes a look into their family dynamics. How might Bob and Levi be contributing to Tiffani's recklessness? Plus, hear from Tiffani. You may be surprised to hear why she says she acts out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents seek Dr. Phil's help for an out-of-control teen.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents say their out-of-contol teen daughter is corrupting her younger sister.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Families fight – that’s a fact of life. For most, tempers flare, you make up and life goes on. For sisters Maggie and Marsha however, they haven’t spoken in two years, and the rift has their family trapped in the middle. See their emotional reunion as another sister caught in the crossfire brings the matter before Dr. Phil. Also on the show...they seem like the all-American family, but these two sisters feel their once solid family bond is a distant memory. Join one of them as she confesses to her parents her true feelings, and hear how she suppressed a devastating secret for years. Tune in as Dr. Phil gives them the tools to bridge their emotional divide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Where there’s a will, there’s a war! Jay says he was betrayed and ripped off by his sister Carole. She says her brother owes her money from their father's estate. She wants him to pay up. But is their family feud really about the money? After more than three years without speaking to each other, the gloves come off! Then, Christy borrowed $100,000 from her mother but refuses to pay the money back until her mother kicks out the convicted sex offender she’s been living with.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Six months ago, Ed revealed to his wife of 12 years that he'd been having an affair. That news was shocking enough, but shortly after he dropped another bombshell: The mistress is pregnant.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After 12 years of marriage, Ed revealed to Kandi that he'd been having an affair and his mistress is now pregnant. Dr. Phil continues his in-depth look at the anatomy of an affair.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with The Dr. Phil Family. Gene and Myra’s marriage has become a war zone, with ugly fights involving name-calling, spitting and throwing objects. Their children were caught in the middle and wrote to Dr. Phil for a family intervention. To find out if their broken marriage has a chance and to heal the resentment between all the family members, they move into The Dr. Phil House. First, Dr. Phil arranges for Myra to meet Lee, a pregnant self-proclaimed mistress in a long-term relationship with a married man. Will hearing another perspective help Myra let go of her anger and bitterness over Gene’s adulterous past? Next, since Gene admits he treats women like sexual objects, Dr. Phil wants to set him straight. Three successful women arrive at the house, determined to change Gene’s views about the opposite sex. After listening to them speak, Gene breaks down and says he wants to become a better husband. But do the ladies think he’s sincere? Gene and Myra’s three adult children, Melissa, Edwin and Eugene, join them in the house. After trying to have secret conversations off camera, Melissa gets a wake-up call when Dr. Phil knocks on the door. Then, in an exercise designed to get to the root of their resentments for each other, each family member takes a turn in the “hot seat” while the others open up about what they hate about them. Guess which person can’t take the criticism and wants to leave?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with The Dr. Phil Family, an out-of-control, angry group with a long history of infidelities, betrayals and bitter resentments. Melissa’s boyfriend, Randy, joins the family at The Dr. Phil House, but Gene and Myra are not happy to see him. They think that Randy is a liar and a thief, and the reason Melissa has gained about 100 pounds in the last five years. Gene and Myra attempt to talk to Melissa about her weight, but Melissa is anything but receptive. Then, because they often blame each other for the chaos in the family, Melissa and Gene are assigned to bury the hatchet long enough to cook a family dinner together, without help from anyone else. Will these relatives be able to follow the rules? After dinner, a family meeting turns heated with accusations and tearful confessions. Dr. Phil joins the family and confronts Melissa and Randy about their sometimes violent relationship and Melissa’s mismanagement of her health. Can this couple create a nurturing relationship for the sake of their autistic child? Will Melissa do what it takes to gain control over her weight?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After all their hard work, the latest Dr. Phil Family receives some surprises from Dr. Phil! He informs Melissa that everything she needs to get her life back on track is headed her way: a complete health evaluation, personal trainer, nutritionist, and food service delivered to her door. In addition, she’ll receive help for her depression and be connected with a developmental disabilities specialist for her autistic son. But it all comes with a condition: Melissa and Randy need to heal their toxic relationship. Then, a talk with Myra and Gene leads to a tearful apology. And, will a one-on-one with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin, help Myra see that she deserves to be treated with dignity and respect? Will Myra set some standards in her broken marriage? Will there even be a marriage to speak of when they get home? Dr. Phil has some strong words for Gene. Next, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity pits brother against brother as Edwin and Eugene audition for a Hollywood talent agent and a casting director. Don’t miss the surprising twist when they get a call from the judges. Then, it’s time to switch gears – literally! Since Myra and Melissa never learned to drive, Dr. Phil sets them up with a driving lesson so they can become more independent. And you won’t believe the prize in store for the women if they pass their driver’s test! Dr. Phil sits down with the entire family one last time. Will they use the tools he gave them to build healthier relationships?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Doug and Debbie's once-perfect family has been shattered by the frightening reality that they could lose their 21-year-old son, Brandon, to drugs. Dr. Phil lays the groundwork for a successful intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In an exclusive interview, Gabby Petito’s parents speak out all together for the first time since the 22-year-old “Van Life” vlogger's body was discovered in Grand Teton National Park in Wyoming. They also honor her life and memory, and discuss what they hope will be her legacy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part 2 of Dr. Phil’s exclusive interview with Gabby Petito’s parents, who are all sitting down together for the first time, they share where they believe Brian Laundrie may be hiding, and what they hope happens to him if he was involved in Gabby’s death. Plus, see their reaction to the latest developments in their daughter’s case.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On Thanksgiving Day 2013, the Hutson family’s celebration turned deadly when 19-year-old Rachel fatally shot her mother while her father was out shopping – and then texted her father a photo of her mother’s body. Rachel's lawyers say she had a history of mental illness that had gone undiagnosed for years. Did the added stress of caring for her ailing mother push her to snap? Or did she have a different motive? In an exclusive interview, will what caused her to commit this unthinkable crime finally be revealed? And, Rachel comes face-to-face with her family for the first time since she was sentenced.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jacob’s son Blake was burned at 2 1/2 years old on a treadmill in his sister Ellen’s home at Thanksgiving in 2014. Jacob claims Ellen was 100% responsible for his son’s injuries and scars. Jacob’s wife, Beth, says that their family was uninvited to further Thanksgivings by Ellen. Ellen says that she never uninvited Jacob and his family, is not responsible for Blake’s injuries and says that in the four-and-a-half years Jacob has held this grudge, Blake hasn’t developed scars. Ellen and Jacob’s brother, Ed, says that he’s tried to play mediator, but after Jacob went on a social media rant in February 2019, rehashing the accident and continuing to blame Ellen, he knew that this unhealthy family feud needed bigger help. Can Dr. Phil help these siblings mend fences? Also- Pfizer’s Chief Patient Officer, Dr. Freda Lewis-Hall, discusses what Americans need to know about rheumatoid arthritis.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mothers and their teenage daughters are rife for conflict under normal circumstances, but what happens when one party turns violent? Victoria wrote to Dr. Phil after she says her 18-year-old daughter, Jessica, physically attacked her on multiple occasions, leaving a gash in her head from a cellphone and her house damaged, as well as her body bruised after a Thanksgiving day family throw down. Victoria says she’s tried everything she can to help Jessica and she’s afraid her daughter is going to end up homeless, in jail, or dead without Dr. Phil’s help.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A desperate search for a missing 2-year-old boy in Texas, and a horrifying new discovery. Baby James’ family say they haven’t seen the toddler since Thanksgiving and claim his mother gave them a string of weak excuses when they asked where he was. In an exclusive interview, James’ great aunt says she feared something terrible had happened to the baby. She made a secret recording of her niece, the child’s mother, D’Lanny Chairez, who insisted that she placed her son for adoption. But James' great aunt says she wasn’t buying it, and when she went into D’Lanny’s home to search for James, she says what she found horrified her -- a terrible smell and a bloody blanket that police believe came from the baby’s crib. Was D’Lanny telling the truth about her son’s whereabouts? Don’t miss the shocking update.

programme.desc: Families fight – that’s a fact of life. For most, tempers flare, you make up and life goes on. For sisters Maggie and Marsha however, they haven’t spoken in two years, and the rift has their family trapped in the middle. See their emotional reunion as another sister caught in the crossfire brings the matter before Dr. Phil. Also on the show...they seem like the all-American family, but these two sisters feel their once solid family bond is a distant memory. Join one of them as she confesses to her parents her true feelings, and hear how she suppressed a devastating secret for years. Tune in as Dr. Phil gives them the tools to bridge their emotional divide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you know people that can’t mind their own business? Dr. Phil’s first guest is fed up with her mother-in-law’s constant meddling in financial affairs, parenting, and even their intimate relations! So why does her husband frequently side with his parents? The friction mounts when members of this blended family speak out! Then, meet a 23-year-old woman who says her grandmother is smothering her. Can Dr. Phil help this dueling duo redefine their boundaries? Plus, find out how to deal with annoying backseat drivers before they drive you insane!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Everyone knows people that love to bicker. But what happens when the bickering escalates into verbal abuse and violence? Dr. Phil checks in with past guests Troy and Tammy whose explosive arguing is the primary dynamic in their marriage. Have they been able to break the cycle of drama or are they one step closer to divorce? Then—meet a single mother of five who worries that her children’s bickering may lead to fatal consequences! She thinks they’re out of control. So why is her daughter pointing the finger at her? Dr. Phil helps her end the fighting once and for all.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil revisits some of the most high-profile custody battles fought in the public eye. Model Bridget Marks is in the fight of her life after a court ordered her to turn her 4-year-old twin girls over to their father. Now, Dr. Phil gets her side of the story and what she plans to do next. And, when a mother decides she wants to move to Alaska with her kids, her ex-husband decides he’s going to fight her to the bitter end. Plus, a 12-year-old boy is caught between the grandmother who raised him and a mother desperate to reclaim him. Dr. Phil addresses the real casualties of these wars - the children - and talks about rules to live by when custody battles arise.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Where there’s a will, there’s a war! Jay says he was betrayed and ripped off by his sister Carole. She says her brother owes her money from their father's estate. She wants him to pay up. But is their family feud really about the money? After more than three years without speaking to each other, the gloves come off! Then, Christy borrowed $100,000 from her mother but refuses to pay the money back until her mother kicks out the convicted sex offender she’s been living with.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil shares advice for dealing with rude, crude and obnoxious behavior from your family members.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every household has a relative who stirs the pot and creates conflict and havoc for the rest of the family. These troublemakers too often make holidays and family gatherings a living hell!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On Thanksgiving Day 2013, the Hutson family’s celebration turned deadly when 19-year-old Rachel fatally shot her mother while her father was out shopping – and then texted her father a photo of her mother’s body. Rachel's lawyers say she had a history of mental illness that had gone undiagnosed for years. Did the added stress of caring for her ailing mother push her to snap? Or did she have a different motive? In an exclusive interview, will what caused her to commit this unthinkable crime finally be revealed? And, Rachel comes face-to-face with her family for the first time since she was sentenced.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jacob’s son Blake was burned at 2 1/2 years old on a treadmill in his sister Ellen’s home at Thanksgiving in 2014. Jacob claims Ellen was 100% responsible for his son’s injuries and scars. Jacob’s wife, Beth, says that their family was uninvited to further Thanksgivings by Ellen. Ellen says that she never uninvited Jacob and his family, is not responsible for Blake’s injuries and says that in the four-and-a-half years Jacob has held this grudge, Blake hasn’t developed scars. Ellen and Jacob’s brother, Ed, says that he’s tried to play mediator, but after Jacob went on a social media rant in February 2019, rehashing the accident and continuing to blame Ellen, he knew that this unhealthy family feud needed bigger help. Can Dr. Phil help these siblings mend fences? Also- Pfizer’s Chief Patient Officer, Dr. Freda Lewis-Hall, discusses what Americans need to know about rheumatoid arthritis.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mothers and their teenage daughters are rife for conflict under normal circumstances, but what happens when one party turns violent? Victoria wrote to Dr. Phil after she says her 18-year-old daughter, Jessica, physically attacked her on multiple occasions, leaving a gash in her head from a cellphone and her house damaged, as well as her body bruised after a Thanksgiving day family throw down. Victoria says she’s tried everything she can to help Jessica and she’s afraid her daughter is going to end up homeless, in jail, or dead without Dr. Phil’s help.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A desperate search for a missing 2-year-old boy in Texas, and a horrifying new discovery. Baby James’ family say they haven’t seen the toddler since Thanksgiving and claim his mother gave them a string of weak excuses when they asked where he was. In an exclusive interview, James’ great aunt says she feared something terrible had happened to the baby. She made a secret recording of her niece, the child’s mother, D’Lanny Chairez, who insisted that she placed her son for adoption. But James' great aunt says she wasn’t buying it, and when she went into D’Lanny’s home to search for James, she says what she found horrified her -- a terrible smell and a bloody blanket that police believe came from the baby’s crib. Was D’Lanny telling the truth about her son’s whereabouts? Don’t miss the shocking update.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Six months ago, Ed revealed to his wife of 12 years that he'd been having an affair. That news was shocking enough, but shortly after he dropped another bombshell: The mistress is pregnant.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After 12 years of marriage, Ed revealed to Kandi that he'd been having an affair and his mistress is now pregnant. Dr. Phil continues his in-depth look at the anatomy of an affair.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Shannon, 24, says two years ago, her ex-boyfriend stabbed her multiple times, and she feels betrayed by her mother, Dian, because she didn’t visit her in the hospital. Can they make peace with the past and fix their relationship? Plus, Kasey says she wants her 24-year-old son to stop living at home and playing video games all the time -- but is she part of the problem?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you think about everything you eat with the fear of gaining weight? Do you skip meals to lose weight? What about your teenager? Dr. Phil takes an eye-opening journey into the mind of an anorexic and bulimic. Meagan is 26 and weighs only 73 pounds. She starves herself all day, abuses laxatives, and binges and purges at night when everyone is asleep. She's been battling her eating disorders for over 10 years. Her parents, Donna and Tom, fear she could die at any moment and admit they enable Meagan’s disease to keep the peace. Meagan’s sister, Erika, says she’s so disgusted with her sister, she can’t stand being in the same room with her. When one member of the family has an eating disorder, it can make the entire family dysfunctional. Will Meagan accept help, and will her family do the work necessary to support her? Do you know the warning signs of someone who is at risk of developing an eating disorder? Parents, you can’t afford to miss this show!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his discussion with Meagan and her family. Meagan is a 26-year-old anorexic and bulimic who weighs only 73 pounds. She rules her house with her eating disorders, and her family is saying enough is enough. Will she give up control and accept help before it’s too late? And, get an update on Jennifer’s family. Three months ago, they sought Dr. Phil’s help for their daughter, who was battling anorexia and bulimia. How is Jennifer doing now? Her parents, Sue and Allan, and sister, Abbey, share with Meagan’s family what they’ve learned while Jennifer has been in treatment and how they can take their lives back and stop enabling the disease. Plus, test your knowledge of eating disorders. Would you recognize the warning signs?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Paul was his family’s rock and role model, so when he suddenly passed away, his wife and four children say their lives were shattered. Debbie, who was married to Paul for 30 years, says she shut down after his death and doesn’t know how to unite her brood. Sisters Jamie, Erica and Tayler say they don’t know how to properly grieve, they’re always fighting with each other, and they’re upset that their brother, Paul, turned his back on them. Paul says he didn’t run away from his loved ones; he has his own family and says he feels stretched thin. Find out the secret Erica’s been keeping that threatens to throw everyone into further turmoil, and hear the final wish Jamie’s dad had for her. If you’re grappling with grief after the loss of a relative, learn how to find closure and peace.
