programme.desc: Megan Fudge and Karin Kochis take on Ryann Foster and Lee Whitwell in this Women's Split Pro Doubles semifinal match.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: March 21, 2023 - the Peoria Pythons and Scottsdale Scorchers play a fierce game of pickleball - live at The Orchard!

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Witness a classic ACC vs. Big 12 showdown at the Arch Pickleball Center as the Virginia Cavaliers and UCF Knights battle through a grueling series that pushes both teams to the brink. The Racing pace of the "firefights" at the net keeps spectators on edge as both sides trade rapid-fire volleys in a test of pure reaction time. Technical Skills are on full display with precision dinks and rare "Bert" shots that highlight the high-level strategy required for collegiate dominance. In a Freestyle display of grit and determination, the match culminates in a high-voltage sudden death round where every shot determines who will advance in the national bracket.

programme.title: Breaking Pickleball
programme.desc: The final two teams battle it out for the Orchard Championship Cup.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Pei-chuan Kao and Mari Humberg face off in the US Open Pickleball Championship's Women's Pro Singles backdraw quarterfinals.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: The University of Virginia (UVA) and James Madison University (JMU) ignite an intense intrastate rivalry in a semifinal clash at the 2024 DUPR Virginia Beach Super Regional. UVA enters the arena as a statistical powerhouse, led by former national champion Alexandra McDonald, whose dominant drives in Women's Doubles put the JMU Dukes under immediate pressure. The intensity remains high as the competition moves into Men's Doubles, where the Burns brothers for UVA face off against JMU’s Ryan Morneau and Carter Work in a high-stakes battle for a spot in the championship final.

programme.title: All Florida Pro League
programme.desc: This episode provides courtside commentary on Game 3 of the All Florida Pro League (AFPL) Stop 4 in Sarasota, Florida, featuring the Fort Myers Flamingos and the Old Town Bangers. The commentators highlight the aggressive play of newcomer Jada Bui and the defensive prowess of Ellie Schele. They also discuss the importance of mental toughness and team chemistry in a high-pressure environment. The episode concludes with a preview of the upcoming men's match.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2021
programme.desc: April 17, 2021 - April 24, 2021 at the East Naples Community Park in Naples, Florida

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Karin Kockis and Spencer Moorman compete in the Gold Medal match for Women's Senior Pro at the 2024 Us Open Pickleball Championship.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: In this alternate cut of the Women’s Split Pro Doubles Quarterfinal at the 2024 US Open, Suzanne Leblang & Milan Rane face off against Martina Frantova & Christine Karges in a battle of shot placement, net pressure, and quick resets. Filmed in Naples, Florida, this matchup delivers a new perspective on one of the tournament’s most tactical and fast-paced doubles clashes.

programme.title: The Wager
programme.desc: Jason Kennedy and Wes Burrows challenge Austin North and Doug Ellin.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.desc: This Pro Women's Doubles match at the Minto US Open Pickleball Championships features the dynamic team of Anna Leigh Waters and Lee Waters facing off against the formidable duo of Walczak and Harris. The Waters team, known for their aggressive play and powerful shots, including Anna Leigh's unique heavy topspin cross-court backhand roll, aim to dominate the court. Walczak, a native of Poland with collegiate tennis experience, and Harris seek to overcome the Waters' early lead and challenge their expected path to the Championship court.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: The atmosphere at Mumbai's Jio World Garden is electric as the host team, Mumbai Pickle Power, rides the momentum of their first season victory into a high-stakes clash against the Rajasthan Titans. With Rajasthan still hunting for their elusive first win of the season, the pressure is at a breaking point for both squads as they fight to climb the "Band of Honor" leaderboard. Witness tactical masterclasses as veteran Lorena Dupnik faces off against Jada Bui in a strategic battle of precision, and feel the intensity of the men's singles where superstars like Brandon Lane and Jack Foster showcase explosive athleticism. From game-changing "Pickle Plays" to high-stakes challenges and the presence of celebrity guests like Rishabh Pant, every rally in this tie is a desperate fight for survival on the road to the semifinals.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.desc: Get ready for a great singles match as Simone Jardim takes on Kristen Kopp at the Usopp National Pickleball Center. This venue, home to the Usopp Pickleball Academy, is a hub for lessons and training, making it an amazing facility for all things pickleball.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: A high-level pickleball match from the 2025 NCPA Utah Regional as the Utah Tech collegiate program's top two teams battle head-to-head. Filmed live at Club Pickleball USA in Orem, Utah, this episode features the Women's Doubles showdown between the #2 seed Utah Tech 1, featuring Lauren Mercado and Ella Boydston, against the #3 seed Utah Tech 2, anchored by NCPA commentator Dillon Champigny and rising star Mary Monson. Experience the intense collegiate format, which includes singles, doubles, and mixed doubles, a design optimized based on direct player feedback.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: The atmosphere at the Arch Pickleball Center in Saint Louis reaches a fever pitch as the Utah Tech Trailblazers face off against the FAU Owls in a high-stakes semifinal showdown. This match showcases a "racing" intensity as Liam Duffin looks to maintain Utah Tech's momentum following their grueling victory over Colorado. Fans are treated to the technical "skills" and "freestyle" shot-making of Alex LaMacchia, whose crafty drop shots and highlight-reel volleys keep the score neck and neck throughout the opening game. With a spot in the National Championship on the line, both squads must navigate high-pressure video challenges and tactical timeouts in a match many spectators believe is worthy of the final itself.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: Beth Bellamy & Yates Johnson compete with Megan Fudge & Paul Olin in a Bronze medal match

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: The 2024 DUPR Collegiate Virginia Beach Super Regional concludes with a heavy-hitting championship showdown between two of the nation's premier pickleball programs: the University of Virginia and the University of North Carolina. The match features elite talent, including former national champion Alexandra McDonald for UVA and standout players like Ian Hutter and Sarah Carpenter for the Tar Heels.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: Watch a masterclass in senior pro pickleball as Peter Prodanov and Scott Moore take on Scott Crandall and Jose Derisi. With explosive hands, strategic play, and experience driving every point, this US Open quarterfinal is a showcase of skill, grit, and high-level doubles tactics.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: In this gripping quarterfinal from the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships, Helen Wilhelm and Anna Shirley face Suzanne LeBlang and Teresa Tarn in a thrilling three-game battle. Featuring powerful strokes, smart resets, and tactical momentum shifts, this senior pro women’s doubles match highlights both experience and finesse. Watch as the teams adapt and clash in a showcase of skill and strategy at the highest level.

programme.title: Pickleball England
programme.desc: October 28, 2023 - It's the English Nationals Open in the Bolton Arena, Greater Manchester. Teams face off to compete for victory!

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: The atmosphere reaches a fever pitch as the Ohio State Buckeyes and Florida Gators face off in a high-stakes battle for the 2023 DUPR Collegiate National Championship. We also have on board Colin and his wife, Amanda from Grundens, and our friend Toby from Mag Bay Lures and Mag Bay Resort down in Baja, Mexico. programme.desc: GLORY 16 slams into Denver with the Welterweight World Title fight, the Heavyweight Contender Tournament, and the debut of USA Martial Arts sensation Pat Barry. Belgian striker Marc de Bonte will battle Armenia's technical machine Karapet Karapetyan for the vacant GLORY Welterweight World Title, guaranteeing a fast, explosive war. At the heaviest end of the GLORY ranks, the big-boys are set to battle it out for a higher ranked spot in the Heavyweight division, and a chance to fight for the Title later within the year. The lineup pits Errol "The Bonecrusher" Zimmerman versus "Bangin" Ben Edwards in a semi-final, and Sergei "The Paratrooper" Kharitonov vs. Anderson "Braddock" Silva in another semi-final. The tournament winner will have to win two fights in one night to claim the prize, and the right to fight for a bigger prize later in the year. Also at Heavyweight, in a tournament reserve match, MMA veteran Pat "HD" Barry returns to his original love of kickboxing, facing another GLORY debutant in the shape of Zack "The Black Warrior" Mwekassa.

Also featured on the card, GLORY debutants Jonas Julio and Javier Aparicio will square off in a welterweight clash, and top-five GLORY featherweight contender Denis Wosik will go for his third consecutive victory as he takes on Marcos Rios. programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed for the opportunity to follow along the guys from Trinity Oaks for Bucks for the Brave. The men and women that served in our armed services and as first responders, had jobs that required the, to be willing to sacrifice their own lives every day, in order to protect or save someone else's. Not many of us can say that, nor understand what that truly means. The things they've had to see, and the sacrifices they've made in their daily lives, can have a profound impact on them. Trinity Oaks' Bucks for the Brave platform allows the loved ones and communities that support these heroes to share their stories and unite us all in honoring and recognizing their service to our great nation. We are proud to continue to be a part of this incredible program, getting these heroes in the outdoors for the hunt of a lifetime.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Returning to Venice, Louisiana for the first time in nearly a decade, Rush reconnects with longtime friends Eric and Monique Newman of Journey South Outfitters for an unforgettable inshore fishing adventure in the heart of the Mississippi River Delta. With reports of massive schools of redfish cruising the beaches, Monique (“Moe”) must decide whether to trust the intel and make a bold run down the coast—or rely on her own instincts built from years on the water. The mission is simple: put Rush on a true bull redfish and see if he has what it takes to earn a spot in her coveted “Over 40-Inch Club.” This trip highlights why Venice, Louisiana is considered one of the premier inshore fisheries in the country—and why having the right guide makes all the difference. programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: The 1985 Super B.A.S.S. IV Tournament becomes an instant all-time classic as Hank Parker and Gary Klein have a showdown on the St. Johns River in Palatka, Florida. Tune in to see who emerges victorious and cements themselves in Bassmaster history.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: In Chattanooga, Tennessee, the 1985 Bassmaster Series continues with the Chattanooga Invitational, where only one angler can claim the $100,000 prize. See who rises above the rest to claim the top spot and bring home the Bassmaster Elite Series trophy.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: Lake Okeechobee's legacy is cemented during the 1985 Bassmaster Series as anglers make their mark in Clewiston, Florida as the Florida Invitational comes to a close. Only one angler can stand above the rest, tune in to find out who brings home the trophy and the $100,000 prize.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: The 1986 New York Invitational on the St. Lawrence River continues the Bassmaster Series in Clayton, New York. Jimmy Houston and Mickey Bruce take part in an all-time race to see who takes home the top prize and cements themselves in the legacy of the New York Invitational.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: The Bassmasters tour heads north to the historic Hudson River for a thrilling invitational in Catskills, NY. Hosted by Ray Scott, this episode delivers intense competition, expert commentary, and scenic river views.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: Join host Ray Scott and the Bassmaster crew as 250 of the nation’s top anglers descend on Florida’s legendary Lake Okeechobee. In this fall showdown, Charles “Slow-Hand” Murphy uses finesse and patience to outlast the competition and land a career-defining win.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: The 1987 Georgia Invitational takes place in LaGrange, Georgia, where a two angler race takes place. Will Tom Mann bring home the trophy, or will hot-on-his-heels Rick Clunn come from behind and steal the win away on West Point Lake in this Bassmaster Series tournament?

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: In this thrilling installment of Bassmasters, 250 elite anglers converge on Florida’s famed Lake Okeechobee for the Top 100 Pro-Am. Featuring intense competition, expert commentary, and the strategic use of lipless crankbaits in pepper grass, this episode captures the grit and glory of tournament fishing.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A young woman arrives via helicopter to the Royal Melbourne Hospital’s emergency department after her car slammed into a tree. programme.title: Paramedics

programme.title: Paramedics

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Oh, what a ripe, sweet, and beautifully-smelling raspberry! Masha has gone picking berries, but Bear had strictly forbidden it. Now she'll do anything to avoid admitting that she disobeyed him. The situation goes too far, and everyone in the forest gets involved in the debacle. So what will the strict Bear do?

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it’s her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf’s tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf’s tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat’s voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. - One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar’s insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman’s daughter, the second one married the merchant’s daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Kids love daydreaming and show off their imaginary successes, aren’t they?! Masha and Panda grip into a real cheating competition! This would be very funny story If only all the secrets were not revealed all at the most inopportune time!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
